reason: A proposes a physically plausible, controlled comparison linking interface density and misfit-stress-mediated dislocation pinning to measurable creep resistance, with clear boundaries and falsification criteria. B is undermined by unsupported precise misfit and performance values, questionable claims about negative misfit/slow cooling producing coherent serrated interfaces, and an inaccurate boundary suggesting diffusion-controlled creep is primarily a lower-temperature mechanism.
